text:
Maya CSM: Hey team — quick post-smoke sync from Acme private deployment. Ran through egress rules + KMS handshake. See notes below.
Dan Eng: thanks — list?
Maya CSM: 1) Network: VPN peering up, but NAT config missing for cluster -> need 10.4.0.0/16 SNAT. Acme confirmed?
Alex (Acme): confirmed 10.4.0.0/16 will be SNAT'd by our edge. ETA today EOD.
Priya Sec: KMS: key policies look good but rotation schedule is blank. Can we set to 90d? Also need CMKs in same region as logs.
Sarah CE: Audit logs: forwarding to splunk-priv-acme via TLS. Found one gap: control-plane logs not included in subscription filter.
Dan Eng: can you paste the subscription config?
Sarah CE: `aws logs put-subscription-filter --log-group-name /redwood/priv-acme --filter-name cp-logs --destination-arn arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:destination:splunk-priv-acme` — missing cp pattern.
Maya CSM: Action items: Acme to confirm NAT config (Alex), Ops to add log subscription (Sarah), Priya to add key rotation (Priya).
Alex (Acme): NAT done, test shows outbound tokens ok, but some connections to us-east-1 KMS failing.
Priya Sec: Which error?
Alex (Acme): `AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to use KMS key` when calling Encrypt.
Dan Eng: likely missing kms:Encrypt for the service role. Add policy snippet:
Dan Eng: `{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-efgh"
}`
Priya Sec: I'll update policy and confirm.
Maya CSM: We're tracking renewal risk for this account — onboarding delayed by two days due to the cp logs gap. Not high risk but flagging for renewals team.
Maya CSM: Also scheduling an enablement deep-dive next Tue 11am PT — covers rollout strategies & cost controls. Sarah to send invite?
Sarah CE: invite sent to acme@acme.com, added agenda + quickstart link.
Alex (Acme): thanks. Quick feedback: private docs around "audit-log mapping" were a bit sparse — could use an example mapping of Redwood events -> Splunk fields.
Maya CSM: noted, we'll add a cookbook snippet. Dan, can you sketch?
Dan Eng: will drop a sample mapping in the doc by EOD.
deploy-bot: Deployment 6423456789 completed for acme-priv (green) :white_check_mark:
Maya CSM: closing blockers after policies verified. moving to post-cutover health check next week.
Alex (Acme): all good from my side, ping me if you need more logs.
